expected_findings.description: Bill of lading shows port of loading Chennai, but the credit requires Tuticorin.
Documents were presented 24 days after shipment; the credit allows 21 days.
Insurance covers 100% of the CIF value; the credit requires at least 110%.
Gross weight conflicts: packing list 1,180.0 kg, bill of lading 1,108.0 kg.

expected_accepted.note: Bill of lading describes the goods generally as 'cotton garments'. This does not conflict with the invoice or credit (UCP 600 Art. 14(e)).
Packing list abbreviates 'Speicherstrasse' to 'Speicherstr.'. Address detail need not be identical (UCP 600 Art. 14(j)).
